text: Offer a Stripe-hosted, redirect-based checkout page as an alternative to embedding

text: Accept payments via 125+ local payment methods for one-time and subscription purchases

text: Automatically retry failed subscription payments (smart retries) to prevent churn

text: Provide recovery analytics on subscription payment failure and recovery rates

text: Cancel a payment before completion at no cost, or refund after it succeeds
